shared_elements: figures facing one another across the field
register divisions separating figural scene from text
stela-format rectangular panel with organised horizontal bands
justification: Both surfaces combine profile human figures with blocks of the same kind of pictographic sign-groups arranged in horizontal registers, and in both the figures confront one another across the field with text placed between or above them — a fairly specific shared scheme including the same relief-carving and profile-figure conventions (frontal shoulders, staff/gesture toward a facing figure). The biggest difference in content is the balance and placement: A devotes most of its field to two large standing figures flanking a central offering arrangement under an arched winged/emblematic top, with only brief sign labels, whereas B is dominated by many lines of text with two small kneeling/seated figures relegated to the bottom corners.
